audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot tabernacle construction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for artisan work, excessive freewill offering, curtains, coverings, frames, bars, veil, and screen.

verses.restored: Bezalel and Oholiab and every wise-hearted man in whom YHWH gave wisdom and understanding to know how to do all work of service of holy place shall do according to all YHWH commanded.

familiar.text: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.

verses.restored: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and every wise-hearted man in whose heart YHWH gave wisdom, everyone whose heart lifted him to draw near to the work to do it.

familiar.text: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

verses.restored: They took from before Moses all contribution that children of Israel brought for work of service of holy place, to do it. And they still brought to him freewill offering morning by morning.

familiar.text: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.

verses.restored: All wise ones doing all work of holy place came, each from his work that they were doing,

familiar.text: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

verses.restored: and said to Moses, The people are bringing more than enough for service of work that YHWH commanded to do.

familiar.text: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.

verses.restored: Moses commanded, and they passed a voice in camp, saying, Man and woman shall not make any more work for contribution of holy place. So the people were restrained from bringing.

familiar.text: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

verses.restored: The work they had was sufficient for all work to do it, and more.

familiar.text: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

verses.restored: Every wise-hearted one among doers of work made dwelling-place with ten curtains of fine twisted linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, with cherubim, work of skilled designer.

familiar.text: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

verses.restored: Length of one curtain twenty-eight cubits, width four cubits; one measure for all curtains.

familiar.text: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.

verses.restored: He joined five curtains one to another, and five curtains joined one to another.

familiar.text: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.

verses.restored: He made loops of blue on edge of one curtain at end of set; thus he did on edge of outer curtain in second set.

familiar.text: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

verses.restored: Fifty loops he made in one curtain, and fifty loops on edge of curtain in second set; loops were opposite each other.

familiar.text: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.

verses.restored: He made fifty gold clasps and joined curtains one to another with clasps, and dwelling-place became one.

familiar.text: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

verses.restored: He made curtains of goats' hair for tent over dwelling-place; eleven curtains he made.

familiar.text: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

verses.restored: Length of one curtain thirty cubits, width four cubits; one measure for eleven curtains.

familiar.text: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.

verses.restored: He joined five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves.

familiar.text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

verses.restored: He made fifty loops on edge of outer curtain of set, and fifty loops on edge of curtain of second set.

familiar.text: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

verses.restored: He made fifty bronze clasps to join tent to be one.

familiar.text: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

verses.restored: He made covering for tent of reddened ram skins and covering of durable hides above.

familiar.text: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.

verses.restored: He made frames for dwelling-place of acacia wood, standing upright.

familiar.text: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

verses.restored: Ten cubits length of frame, and one and a half cubits width of one frame.

familiar.text: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

verses.restored: Two tenons for one frame, joined each to another; so he did for all frames of dwelling-place.

familiar.text: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

verses.restored: He made frames for dwelling-place: twenty frames for south side, toward south.

familiar.text: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

verses.restored: Forty silver bases he made under twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons and two bases under another frame for its two tenons.

familiar.text: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

verses.restored: For second side of dwelling-place, north side, he made twenty frames,

familiar.text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

verses.restored: and their forty silver bases, two bases under one frame and two bases under another frame.

familiar.text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.restored: For rear of dwelling-place westward, he made six frames.

familiar.text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

verses.restored: Two frames he made for corners of dwelling-place in rear.

familiar.text: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

verses.restored: They were doubled below and together complete at top into one ring; thus he did for both corners.

familiar.text: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

verses.restored: There were eight frames and their silver bases, sixteen bases, two bases under each frame.

familiar.text: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

verses.restored: He made bars of acacia wood, five for frames of one side of dwelling-place,

familiar.text: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.restored: five bars for frames of second side of dwelling-place, and five bars for frames at rear westward.

familiar.text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

verses.restored: He made middle bar to pass through midst of frames from end to end.

familiar.text: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

verses.restored: He overlaid frames with gold, made their rings of gold as housings for bars, and overlaid bars with gold.

familiar.text: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

verses.restored: He made veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, with cherubim, work of skilled designer.

familiar.text: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

verses.restored: He made for it four pillars of acacia, overlaid them with gold, their hooks gold, and cast for them four silver bases.

familiar.text: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

verses.restored: He made screen for entrance of tent, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, work of embroiderer,

familiar.text: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

verses.restored: and its five pillars and their hooks, and overlaid their tops and bands with gold; their five bases were bronze.

familiar.text: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

translation_notes: Construction follows command pattern from Exodus 26 but now emphasizes actual wise-hearted labor.
Freewill offering exceeds need; Moses restrains giving. This is crucial anti-extraction safeguard.
Repeated one-ness of dwelling/tent is carried into construction.
safety_note: The people bring more than enough and are stopped from bringing more. Sacred work must not become endless fundraising or spiritualized extraction.
